spans.s:
Sorcery,Ⓒs.ⒹEMdrajAlaM, mAyA, kusfti f., yogaH, aBicAraH (black art).
Ⓝ[Sorcer]er,Ⓒs.ⒹEMdra-jAlikaH, mAyAkaraH, aBicAravid.
Ⓝ[Sorcer]ess,Ⓒs.ⒹyoginI, mAyinI, aBicAriRI.

Sordid,Ⓒa.ⒹnIca, kfpaRa, kutsita, aDama, dIna, jaGanya, niMdya; See Mean.
Ⓑ
 2 malina, malI-masa.

Sore,Ⓒs.ⒹkzataM, vraRaH-RaM, aruz n., IrmaM.
Ⓔa.Ⓓsa-ruja, jAtavyaTa, duHKita, kzata, savraRa; savedana, savyaTa, sparSAsaha.
Ⓑ
 2 pIqAkara (rI f.), kazwa-kleSa-prada, duHKada.
Ⓑ
 3 ugra, tIvra, dAruRa, guru; ‘s(ore) throat’ kaMWapAkaH, kaMWaruj f.
Ⓝ[Sore]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹBfSaM, atIva, nitAMtaM, ugraM, dAruRaM, sutarAM, balavat.

Sorrel,Ⓒs.ⒹcukraH, sahasraveDin m., amlavetasaH, SataveDI.
Ⓔa.ⒹpiMgala, piSaMga.

Sorrow,Ⓒs.ⒹSokaH, Suc f., duHKaM, KedaH, kleSaH, ADiH, saMtApaH, Arti f., vyaTA; See Grief.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹSuc 1 P, Kid pass., vyaT 1 A; See Grieve.
Ⓝ[Sorrow]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹsaSoka, So-kArta-Akula-anvita-upahata-Avizwa, duHKita, saMtapta, duHKin, duHKArta, udvigna, vizaRRa, dIna, durmanas, Kinna, avasanna, mlAna, vimanas.
Ⓑ
 2 Socya, SocanIya, SokAspadIBUta, duHKAvaha.
Ⓝ[Sorrow]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹsaSokaM, saKedaM, sodvegaM, saduHKaM.
ⓃSorry,Ⓒa.ⒹduHKita, duHKin, Kinna, kazwApanna, &c.; See Sorrowful.
Ⓑ
 2 dIna, anu-, Socya, kfpaRa, anukaMpya; ‘s(orry) for oneʼs past conduct’ sAnuSaya, anutapta; ‘I am s(orry) to hear this’ idaM SrutvA duHKitosmi; ‘I am s(orry) to inform you’ &c. iti Bavate nivedanaM me duHKamAvahati, nivedayannahaM kazwApannosmi; ‘s(orry) horse’ kadaSvaH; ‘s(orry) fare’ kadannaM.

Sort,Ⓒs.ⒹprakAraH; viSezaH, BedaH in comp.; jAti f., viDA in comp.; See Manner; ‘a s(ort) of tree’ vfkzaviSezaH-BedaH; ‘out of s(ort)s’ asusTa-asvasTa-SarIra.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹyaTAkramaM-yaTAvargaM rac 10 or vinyas 4 U, vargakrameRa nyas.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓyuj-upapad- pass., ex. by anurUpa, yukta; See Becoming, Proper.
